newsitem.title: USA: US corporate junk bonds firm amid Treasury backup.
newsitem.headline: US corporate junk bonds firm amid Treasury backup.

text.p: U.S. high-yield corporate bonds were well bid on Thursday despite a sell-off in the Treasury market which drove the price of the benchmark 30-year Treasury down about 1-1/2 points, traders said.
In the investment-grade corporate market, however, prices generally tracked Treasuries throughout the day, traders said.
Cable sector investment bonds tighten five to 10 basis points on news that TCI Communications was preparing a cost cutting plan designed to boost the company's financial performance.
